episodes.166113: A stalled front over western Washington brought heavy rains to the coastal mountains in southwest Washington.
episodes.166299: Shallow marine instability enabled convective showers to develop within strong north to northeast boundary layer flow behind a strong cold front, producing isolated gale-force wind gusts near the Upper Florida Keys.

events.narrative: A north northeast wind gust of 37 knots was measured at an automated WeatherFlow station at Alligator Reef Light.

The gauge on the Grays River near Rosburg rose above flood stage of 12.0 feet at 2345PST, crested at 15.5 feet on the 12th at 0715PST, the fell below flood stage at 2330PST.   A mudslide closed SR-4 in both direction near Raistakka Road.
